name: gaps3-rout
description: audit-gaps-3 (gate TI4_RULES_AC): Rout — "At the start of the 'Announce Retreats' step of space combat, if you are the defender: Your opponent must announce a retreat, if able." Base pbd60@122 without the reposted hits prompt (space combat at 308, mentak attacking); setup adds 2 muaat dreadnoughts, which (as /add_units does) starts the space combat afresh: the start of round 1. The defender muaat plays Rout; mentak (home 307 adjacent, so able to retreat) rolling round 1 is refused until it announces a retreat, then rolls. (gate42: the old setup line setting muaat's round tracker made no save, and the add restarts the combat anyway.)
